documents.text: Vehicle struck by a falling tree branch during a storm on 2026-01-25; roof and windshield damaged, described by the adjuster as major structural concern pending inspection.
Roof panel and windshield replacement, structural inspection pending: $2,600.

ground_truth.notes: Reported damage ($2,600) is far below the major-damage benchmark floor ($10,000) for a claim the adjuster flagged as a possible structural concern — estimate looks incomplete.
